metadata.title: The Ultraviolet Catastrophe
metadata.thing: the blackbody glow curve (brightness vs frequency)
chapters: A glow that should be infinite
metadata.long_title: The Ultraviolet Catastrophe — how energy comes in chunks | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: In this video: why counting standing-wave modes makes the classical prediction run away; where equipartition breaks; how energy in whole chunks (E = hν) bends the curve back to zero; and the ratio hν / kT that decides when quantum effects matter.
metadata.short_blurb: The ultraviolet catastrophe, in one minute. Full explainer on the channel.
